claims.claim: RuntimeLab builds from the minimal map skeleton with current Vibe Kernel and CMLib sources, without a CMRE map, mission, commander, or CMRE package dependency.
CMLibControl.SC2Map is a current-source CMLib self-test control with no Kernel or RuntimeLab code and only the Void campaign dependency.
The generated RuntimeLab map has a map-local dispatch fixture, P1/P2 GalaxyVibe BankList, and deterministic Marine/Marauder-versus-Zergling tactical fixture.

An older no-mod CMLib control load reached CreateGame, JoinGame, and loops 46 through 222, but it showed only skeleton units rather than the Ghost self-test sentinel. The instance was then replaced by another workflow, so no current package pass or failure is claimed from that run.

Current live gates require an exclusive SC2 API and GalaxyVibe Bank lease. Another workflow owns port 5000 with a separate API process and a detached CMRE runtime lease, so neither the current CMLib control nor RuntimeLab can be attributed safely.
